facts.text: Mount Mary University provides Grace Scholarships to 20 incoming female high school graduates from Milwaukee or West Milwaukee annually, covering 85% to 95% of tuition for four years.

sources.title: Grace and Caroline Program | Mount Mary University
sources.quote: Every year, Mount Mary University awards Grace Scholarships to 20 female high school students who live in Milwaukee or West Milwaukee, equipping them with everything they need to succeed in college and their chosen career path.

sources.title: Grace and Caroline Program | Mount Mary University
sources.quote: Grace Scholar students receive financial aid and scholarship funds to cover 85%-95% of tuition annually for four years.
